create_dataset_dict: create a DatasetDict with train and test splits from a dictionary of Dataset objects
map_dataset_dict: map a transformation function across all splits of a DatasetDict in batched mode
filter_dataset_dict: filter examples across all splits of a DatasetDict using a predicate function
set_format_dataset_dict: set the output format to numpy torch tensorflow pandas or polars for all splits
shuffle_dataset_dict: shuffle all splits of a DatasetDict with reproducible per-split random seeds
